verdict.rationale: Omnara documents configurable approval gates: you choose which actions need approval, and agents can pause to ask for input. You can also follow progress live and send corrections. This allows gating tool actions such as file writes, but nothing shows a plan-review step that happens before any code changes. Missing for 10: an explicit plan or spec generation step, a review/approve workflow for that plan before execution, documentation of how approval gates apply to code edits, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
